title: Scoops.poly
tagline: Create Portable Web 3.0 Usernames with Scoops.poly to bridge identity with utility on the blockchain
description:
A domain registry for Polygon (an extremely scalable and powerful Layer 2 protocol) to allow users to turn any 1:1 name into a pointer NFT on the blockchain. This project is a solidity dapp based on Polygon that works as a domain registry. We leveraged Covalent for visualizing the nfts, POAP for minting an NFT related to your first .poly scoops domain, and Polygon of course for deploying the contract and communicating with the blockchain.

GitHub Link: https://github.com/BrianHHough/HackFS

OpenSea Link: https://testnets.opensea.io/collection/scoops-domains-on-polygon-v3

Polygonscan Link: https://mumbai.polygonscan.com/address/0xEB2648a8c9aE50605973821855056068103c9b88
how_its_made: This project is a solidity dapp based on Polygon that works as a domain registry. We leveraged Covalent and POAP's dynamic APIs for visualizing the NFTs and metadata associated with the authenticated users, POAP for minting an NFT related to your first .poly scoops domain, IFPS for storing the logo for injecting it into our dynamically generated NFTs as well as serving pictures within our dapp, and Polygon of course for deploying the contract and communicating with the blockchain and running the domain registry service as a minted NFT.
